SpectX Key System – Dark Mode GUI with Expiring Keys

Upgrade your Roblox scripts with a modern, sleek, Apple-inspired key system. Features include:

- Dark Mode & Blur Background – stylish and easy on the eyes

- × Close Button – elegant and intuitive

- Key Verification – secure access for your scripts

- 24-Hour Expiring Keys – automatically tracks verified users

- Copy Key Link & ScriptReward Editable – fully customizable

- Smooth Layout & Gradient – modern, professional design


How to Use:

1. Set your Key, KeyLink, and ScriptReward in your executor.

2. Run the loadstring to display the GUI.

3. Users enter the key to unlock your script.
